note: A central bank guide to digitalising state payments across the monetary union; local governments appear only generically, as parties to payment flows. Its Senegal entries (May 2020 and September 2020) are national treasury and tax platforms: salary and pension payments, E-Tax, DIOTALI, SUNUCMU and the Treasury's connection to the regional payment systems. Nothing is stated about a Senegalese local government office or its connection.
